question: A vendor lends 74,000 rupees at a rate of 12% compound interest per annum, compounded annually. Find the interest for the 3rd year.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The interest for the nth year in compound interest follows a geometric progression.

Interest for the 1st year = 12% of 74000 = ₹8880

Interest for the 3rd year = (1st year Interest) × (1 + R/100)ⁿ−¹

⇒ Interest for 3rd year = 8880 × (1 + 12/100)²

⇒ 8880 × (1.12)² = 8880 × 1.2544 = 11139.072 ≈ ₹11139.07

**∴ The correct answer is ₹11139.07.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹74,000

Rate of Interest (R) = 12% per annum

**Formula Used:**

Amount after n years = P × (1 + R/100)ⁿ

Interest for the nth year = Amount after (n−1) years × (R/100)
